cross_disciplinary_pairing.description: Offline multilingual math and scientific-reasoning assistant for African learners. Solves arithmetic, algebra, geometry and applied word problems - including predictive and data-interpretation tasks - step-by-step in Yoruba, Hausa, Swahili, Igbo and English, with WAEC/JAMB-style exam practice as one deployment rather than the only one.

test_prompts.prompt: A solar panel yields 2 kWh on a sunny day and 0.5 kWh on a cloudy day. If the next three days are sunny, cloudy, sunny, estimate the total energy output and show your working step by step.

Pánẹ́lì òòrùn kan ń pèsè 2 kWh ní ọjọ́ oòrùn, ó sì ń pèsè 0.5 kWh ní ọjọ́ ìkùukùu. Bí ọjọ́ mẹ́ta tó máa bọ̀ bá jẹ́ oòrùn, ìkùukùu, oòrùn, ṣe ìṣirò àpapọ̀ agbára tó máa jáde, kí o sì ṣàlàyé ìgbésẹ̀ kọ̀ọ̀kan.
